title: 20 heroes with powers
problem: The prototype has two simple heroes. The owner approved the folk-tale theme (DEC-006) and the power system (DEC-007) and asked to create and build 20 heroes in total, so the game needs the full roster, ultimates, a hero pick before each match and themed names.
scope: 20 heroes in total: the 12 from hero concept v1 (Ranger and Warden become Rimba and Benteng) plus 8 new ones
Power system per DEC-007: Trait, automatic Power with ranks at levels 1-3, Ultimate at level 4 once per life, +15% damage on the best order
New effects: stun, silence, pull, knockback, shield, heal, poison, reveal, flying, charm, decoys, summons, zones (fog, flood, tide, lanterns)
Pick 2 heroes before each match (the bot picks 2 at random); rematch keeps your picks
Folk-tale names per DEC-006: hero names, Semangat (mana), Pusaka (Core), themed troop card names
Hero portraits show power cooldown and a ready ultimate; status marks on the map
Bot gives orders that suit each hero
Hero roster document generated from the game data so the two never drift apart
exclusions: Balance tuning beyond first numbers (needs playtests)

acceptance.text: All 20 heroes can be picked, played and ordered; each hero's power fires and does what its card says (automated test per hero)
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: tests/heroes.test.ts 23/23 pass; 'all 20 heroes can be picked, played and given every order' plus one kit test per hero (power, trait, ultimate) for all 20

acceptance.text: Each hero's ultimate unlocks at level 4, fires on its trigger once per life, and is ready again after respawn
acceptance.evidence: tests/heroes.test.ts: 'an ultimate unlocks at level 4, fires once, and is ready again after respawn' passes; each hero's ultimate test checks it fires on its trigger and ultReady turns false; Belang's always-on ultimate checked

acceptance.text: Same seed + same moves (with random hero picks) => exactly the same match
acceptance.evidence: tests/determinism.test.ts 4/4 pass, including logged-move replays with random hero picks (seeds 7, 8, 21, 33; 3 and 2 lanes)

acceptance.text: Bot against bot: 100 matches with random hero picks finish with no errors, and every hero appears
acceptance.evidence: npm run soak: 'SOAK 100 matches in 36.2 s, results {blue:34, red:37, draw:29, core:35, towers:29, sudden:7}'; every one of the 20 heroes played (7 to 26 matches each); 20 two-lane matches also pass

acceptance.text: A full match with a hero pick can be played at phone size, start to result screen (browser check), and on the owner's phone
acceptance.evidence: Automated part passed: scripts/phone-check.cjs at iPhone 13 size picked Kail + Seri on the pick screen, played cards, gave a Farm order, and a full match reached the result screen ('PHONE CHECK OK'). Waiting for the owner's own phone.

acceptance.text: Owner plays matches with different heroes and gives a verdict: fun? readable? any hero clearly too strong or too weak?

risks: Twenty heroes on first-guess numbers will be unbalanced until people play them
More effects on a small screen may be hard to read
The bot will not use every hero cleverly
PLAN-001 owner playtest (T1, T6) is still open; this build replaces the preview, so that playtest happens on the new version
cost: RM0. Free tools; private preview page. Several build sessions (estimate).
